author: Parzivl
quote: More of the same, looks better, but runs at 30 FPS, 13 years of waiting for all this hype, maybe they should’ve made us wait longer for a more put together whole game instead of this.

author: Parzivl
quote: This is the definitive edition of the greatest of all time.  I love all of the quality of life changes that they have made.  The small changes in the game are fun and exciting to see particularly towards the end.  The upgraded graphics are amazing and the game looks absolutely beautiful.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
